correctness.rationale: A coefficient-field-fixing unital map is determined by the image of t, necessarily in (t), and all q^3 images are allowed. Formal substitution reverses the order of the corresponding endomorphisms but does not change commutation. Expanding the two compositions gives (a-a^2)v=b(u-u^2) and (a-a^3)w-c(u-u^3)+2bv(u-a)=0. Where both coefficients of v and w are nonzero, each u gives one pair (v,w). At a=-1 in odd characteristic the second equation after eliminating v becomes -(c+b^2)(u-u^3)=0; w is free, giving q^2 or 3q. At a=0,1 in odd characteristic, b nonzero forces u=0 or 1, with v free only for u=a and w always free; b=0 and c nonzero gives three roots and two free coefficients. With b=c=0 these maps are central. In characteristic two the mixed term vanishes and the roots of u^3=u and u^2=u are both {0,1}, so each nonzero (b,c) at a=0,1 gives 2q^2 partners. Counting f in the disjoint strata, taking the first moment and merging coincident exponents at q=2,3 gives the stated polynomial, ordered pair total, probability and center. Independently enumerated q=2,3,4,5,9 by Horner evaluation modulo t^4 using ordinary truncated convolution and comparing both orders for each unordered pair; incremented both centralizer sizes on a match and added self-commutation once per f. Replay using Z/p for prime q, and quadratic bases with x^2+x+1 and x^2+1 for q=4 and 9. The computed histograms matched the formula at all five q; totals were 64, 387, 1216, 2725, 25353. The frozen script and stored counts were inspected, not executed.
